name: piestudio
description: Draw security protocols whose blocks are lines of ProVerif, and verify them with ProVerif 2.05 in the browser
author: Roberto Metere

scripts.prebuild: test -f studio-core/studio-core.d.ts && test -f engine/ProVerifRunner.d.ts || (echo 'studio-core/ or engine/ is empty: scripts/update-core.sh path/to/studio-core, scripts/update-engine.sh path/to/proverif-cryptoverif-wasm' && exit 1)
scripts.test: npm run typecheck && node tests/check-style.ts && node tests/check-language.ts && node tests/check-model.ts && node tests/check-parser.ts && node tests/check-tools.ts && node tests/check-engine.ts && node tests/check-i18n.ts
